title: Signed-in home skips login doors
summary: Signed-in users who open the site home are taken to the in-app dashboard instead of the guest Public Login / Register / Staff Login doors.
changes: Redirect authenticated visitors from `/` to the dashboard so they no longer see the public login doors.
Keep the guest landing page with Public Login, Register, and Staff Login for signed-out visitors.
version_rationale: Patch release: corrects signed-in home routing without changing guest landing or authorization rules.
validation: PHPUnit HomeLandingRedirectTest covers guest doors on `/` and service-user plus Super Admin redirects to the dashboard.
Related home, mascot, theme, maintenance, and guest-auth redirect tests remain green.
composer pre-pr-verify run on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Spike dock field overlap (#131) and later Public UX items remain separate follow-ups.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore the prior guest landing behaviour for authenticated visitors on `/`.
provenance: Signed-in home login doors fix for issue #130, pull request #194.
